findings.evidence: Polynomial.lean:62 `@[simp] theorem signCount_eq_fiberCount ... signCount Z Q σ = fiberCount (...) σ := (rfl)`; lines 81, 92, 102 state the main results with `signCount Z Q ...` on the right; Polynomial.lean:51 `signSum_eq_sum` already had its `@[simp]` removed for the identical reason in the prior round.
findings.fix: Drop `@[simp]` from `signCount_eq_fiberCount` (use it explicitly in the three proofs that need it), or declare `signCount` as an `abbrev` if it is intended to be transparent.
findings.issue: `@[simp]` on `signCount_eq_fiberCount` rewrites `signCount Z Q σ` to its `fiberCount` body, so `signCount` is never a simp normal form; the RHS of `mulVec_signCount`, `fullInverse_signSum`, and `signSum_prod_pow` is destroyed by `simp` before any downstream lemma about `signCount` can fire. This is the same defect the prior round removed from `signSum_eq_sum`.

findings.evidence: roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/RealAlgebraicGeometry/Suggested.lean:52 `def tarskiQuery (p q : R[X]) : ℤ := ∑ x ∈ p.roots.toFinset, ...` and :57-62 `theorem sign_matrix ... tarskiQuery p (∏ i, q i ^ (e i).val) = ∑ σ ...`; README.md:111 `The Lean function is \`tarskiQuery p q\``; grep `tarskiQuery` in code/TauCeti returns no hits; Polynomial.lean:18-21 delegates the root instantiation to the reader.
findings.fix: Add `noncomputable def tarskiQuery (p q : R[X]) : ℤ := signSum p.roots.toFinset q`, a `(rfl)` restatement `tarskiQuery_eq_signSum`, and the specialization of `signSum_prod_pow` (and of `signCount`) to `Z := p.roots.toFinset` as the roadmap's `sign_matrix`. This needs no Sturm machinery so it does not conflict with the stated independence from #9411.
findings.issue: The roadmap's explicit product for this target is the identity on `tarskiQuery p q` at the distinct roots of `p`, and the README names `tarskiQuery p q` as the Lean function. The PR only proves the identity for arbitrary `Z : Finset R` and the docstring (lines 18-21) tells consumers to instantiate `Z := p.roots.toFinset` themselves, so later Layer 3 stages have no named surface to consume.

summary: Prior findings are resolved, but `signCount_eq_fiberCount` is `@[simp]`, which unfolds `signCount` out of every main identity in the file, and the roadmap's named product `tarskiQuery` with the sign-matrix identity at the roots of `p` is left for consumers to instantiate instead of being exposed.
